linux.label: Linux
linux.vaultProvider: Secret Service (libsecret) via the keyring module
linux.vaultAbsentNote: A headless Linux session commonly has no unlocked Secret Service, so "session" persistence is a legitimate observation, not a defect.

darwin.label: macOS
darwin.vaultAbsentNote: A signed macOS build on a logged-in desktop session is expected to reach the Keychain.

win32.label: Windows
win32.vaultAbsentNote: Windows always offers Credential Manager to an interactive user session.

awkwardPaths.comment: Real user home directories contain spaces and non-ASCII; the data root must survive both.
